name: tams-v3
description: Welcome to the **[TAMS-v3](https://github.com/MasterZeeno/TAMS-v3)** repository, where we present a comprehensive **UX/UI redesign** for **Hilmarc's Construction Corporation's Time and Attendance Management System (TAMS).** This project aims to enhance user experience, streamline workflows, and provide a modern and intuitive interface for efficient time and attendance management. For reference, please check **[HCC TAMSv2](https://hcc-tams.com.ph).**
